newsitem.title: PAKISTAN: Pakistani stocks finish at level.
newsitem.headline: Pakistani stocks finish at level.

text.p: Pakistani stocks finished at level on Friday on profit-taking by jobbers in a directionless market before the Saturday-Sunday weekend, dealers at the Karachi Stock Exchange (KSE) said.
The KSE 100-share index closed 0.97 point, or 0.06 percent, lower at 1,551.83 amid 159 losers and 73 gainers in a provisional turnover of 36 million.

Jobbers unloaded speculative stocks and booked profits in the directionless market before the weekend, one dealer said. ICI fell 0.20 to 24.15 rupees and PTCL 0.20 to 25.35. PSO rose 7.00 to 311. -- Ibrahim Khan 9221-5685192
